summary:
Technical fix completed for OneDay Share Your Streak High-Resolution Export (3840 x 4800 px) & Instagram Native Sharing:
1. Created dedicated imageExport.ts utility producing 3840 x 4800 pixel canvas Blob directly via toCanvas and native canvas.toBlob() from an unscaled offscreen DOM container.
2. Verified document.fonts.ready loading and vector/high-res rendering for fonts, SVGs, and emojis.
3. Implemented file magic byte signature validation (FF D8 FF for JPEG, 89 50 4E 47 for PNG), dimension checks (naturalWidth === 3840, naturalHeight === 4800), decodability check (img.decode()), and navigator.canShare validation.
4. Optimized Web Share API file-only JPEG payload with automatic caption copying and graceful fallback download for Android/Instagram.
